props.name: autoComplete
props.description:
The native `autocomplete` attribute, such as `'email'` or `'current-password'`. Browser
autofill is off unless set.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description:
Whether the input is focused after mounting, by script rather than the native `autofocus`
attribute. Focus is skipped when the input is disabled, and `autoFocusDelay` postpones it.

props.name: autoFocusDelay
props.description: Delay in milliseconds between mount and focusing the input. Only used with `autoFocus`.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
Initial value for uncontrolled usage; `null` starts empty. Also the value restored when the
owning form is reset.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Whether the control is disabled: it cannot be interacted with and sets `aria-disabled`.
When omitted, the control inherits `disabled` from the surrounding `Field`; an explicit
`false` overrides the `Field`.

props.name: id
props.description:
The ID of the control's labelable element, which a surrounding `Field` label points to with
`for`. Most controls set it on their focusable element and `PinInput` on its first slot;
`Slider` and `FileUpload` set it on their hidden native input. `CheckboxGroup` and
`RadioGroup` set it on their `<fieldset>`, which the `Field` label names through
`aria-labelledby` instead of `for`. A unique ID is generated when omitted. The control's
related parts (root, hidden input, label, description) derive their IDs from it, so keep it
unique on the page.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Native `maxlength`: the maximum number of characters the user can type. Numeric strings are accepted.

props.name: modifiers
props.description:
Transforms the text before it reaches `onValueChange` and form state, and sets the callback's
value type.

- `trim`: strips surrounding whitespace, also from the displayed text on `change` (blur or Enter).
- `lazy`: updates the value on `change` instead of on every keystroke.
- `number`: parses the text to a `number`; empty or non-numeric text gives `null`.
- `empty`: `'null'` turns an empty (whitespace-only) string into `null`; `'preserve'` keeps the string.
examples:
import { Input } from 'moraine'

<Input
  modifiers={{ number: true, empty: 'null' }}
  onValueChange={(value) => console.log(value)} // number | null
/>

props.name: name
props.description:
The name of the control, used for native form submission. When omitted, the control uses
the name of its form binding or a string `name` set on the surrounding `Field`.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Native blur event handler, called after the `Field` blur notification.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Native change event, after value synchronization and Field notification.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Native focus event handler, called after the `Field` focus notification.

props.name: onInput
props.description:
Native `input` event handler, called after `onValueChange` and the `Field` notification and
before a controlled `value` is restored. It fires on every keystroke, also with
`modifiers.lazy`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Called with the new value, after `modifiers` are applied, as the user edits. It fires on
every keystroke, or on `change` (blur or Enter) with `modifiers.lazy`. Its argument type
follows `modifiers`: `string` by default, `number | null` with `number`, and `string | null`
with `empty: 'null'`.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Hint text shown while the input is empty. It is not a substitute for a label.

props.name: readOnly
props.description:
Whether the control is read-only: the value is visible and focusable but cannot be changed,
and `aria-readonly` is set. When omitted, the control inherits `readOnly` from the
surrounding `Field`.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref callback or variable that receives the native `<input>` element.

props.name: required
props.description:
Whether the control is required, which sets `aria-required` (and the native `required`
attribute where the control renders a native input). When omitted, the control inherits
`required` from the surrounding `Field`.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size of the component.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: type
props.description: The native `type` of the input element, such as `'email'`, `'password'`, or `'search'`.

props.name: value
props.description:
The current value (controlled). `undefined` leaves the input uncontrolled and `null` is a
controlled empty value; the displayed text is restored to this value after every edit, so
update it from `onValueChange`.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual treatment of the component.
